name: LOGIN
layout: u8 header; char login[31]; char password[17]

layout: u8 header; char login[31]; u32 login_key; u8 encrypt_key[16]

name: DIRECT_ENTER
layout: u8 header; char login[31]; char password[17]; u8 slot

name: LOGIN_SUCCESS_4

name: MATRIX_CARD

name: DESTROY_CHARACTER
layout: u8 header; u8 slot; char private_code[8]

name: CHANGE_NAME

name: CREATE_SUCCESS
layout: u8 header; u8 slot; account character record[63]

name: CHANGE_NAME_RESULT

name: ATTACK
layout: u8 header; u8 type; u32 victim_vid; u8 check_a; u8 check_b

name: ITEM_USE_TO_ITEM
layout: u8 header; item_pos source[3]; item_pos target[3]

name: ITEM_DROP_NEW
layout: u8 header; item_pos[3]; u32 gold_or_count; u16 count

name: ITEM_MOVE
layout: u8 header; item_pos source[3]; item_pos target[3]; u16 count

name: CLIENT_VERSION
layout: u8 header; char executable[33]; char build[33]
